description: This file provides a helper enum 'DeviceInfoHelper' that offers functions to retrieve device and application information such as platform string, device family, device model identifier, app version, build number, and version string for display purposes. It uses UIKit and Foundation APIs to gather system, device, and app metadata, primarily for use in Settings, payloads, or device status displays.

classes.name: DeviceInfoHelper
classes.description: A static enum providing methods for retrieving device and app information, used for display and identification in settings, payloads, or device status reporting.

methods.name: platformString
methods.description: Returns a string with the device platform and OS version, e.g., 'iOS 18.0.0' or 'iPadOS 18.0.0', based on interface idiom.

methods.name: platformStringForDisplay
methods.description: Returns a simplified string 'iOS X.Y.Z' suitable for UI display.

methods.name: deviceFamily
methods.description: Returns a string indicating device family: 'iPad', 'iPhone', or 'iOS'.

methods.name: modelIdentifier
methods.description: Identifies the device's model, e.g., 'iPhone17,1', by querying system info.

methods.name: appVersion
methods.description: Returns the app's marketing version string.

methods.name: openClawVersionString
methods.description: Returns a version string combining app version and build, e.g., '1.2.3 (456)'.
